_comment: Graded injection with the strength the probe selected (0.25), on the lexical channel only. The probe said strength 0.25 with min_frac 0.02 gives 37.5% partial contamination with counts spanning 0..2 of 5, but the probe ranked by embedding similarity with a 6-passage injection, whereas the real rate budget injects round(0.005 * 5472) = 27 passages per stratum. This run measures the real distribution, which is the number the validation depends on. template_plus_projection is included deliberately to confirm it stays saturated, since the projection overrides text.
